title: An Expert Called Lindy
coreMove: Use endurance as evidence, without confusing age alone with truth.
sourcePressure: Time becomes a credibility test in uncertain domains because survival under repeated stress reveals what a fresh argument cannot.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Lindy as nostalgia or automatic respect for old things.

sourceAnchors.name: Lindy
sourceAnchors.detail: The sidecar supports Lindy as survival over time used as evidence under uncertainty.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Lindy should land as a stress record, not a museum label: what keeps being used has passed tests no launch deck can fake.
